title: feat: API review points 2-8 — validation, rate limiting, logout, public user info, pagination
body: ## Summary Implements points 2–8 from the API review, each with corresponding tests. All 73 tests pass on the JSON backend. ### Point 2: Configurable password strength validation - `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` setting in `config.py` (default 8, configurable via env) - `validators.py` with `validate_password()` - Pydantic `field_validator` on `UserCreate.password` and `UserUpdate.password` - Password validation on `PUT /api/auth/me/password` ### Point 3: Username format validation - `validate_username()` in `validators.py` (3–50 chars, `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]`) - Pydantic `field_validator` on `UserCreate.username` and `UserUpdate.username` ### Point 4: Rate limiting on login - `rate_limit.py` — in-memory rate limiter (5 failures / 15-min window, returns 429 with `Retry-After`) - Integrated into `POST /api/auth/login` (extract client IP, check/record/reset) ### Point 5: Token revocation / logout - `jti` claim added to access tokens - `_revoked_jtis` set in `auth_utils.py` with `revoke_token()` / `is_token_revoked()` - `get_current_user` rejects tokens with revoked `jti` - `POST /api/auth/logout` endpoint ### Point 6: Alembic migration for FK constraint - New migration `c4e2f9a81b03` adds `fk_users_role_roles` (users.role → roles.name) ### Point 7: Public user info endpoint - `GET /api/users/{user_id}/public` — any authenticated user, returns `{id, name, role}` only - Existing `GET /api/users/{user_id}` remains admin-only (full details minus password) ### Point 8: Database-layer pagination - `get_paginated(skip, limit)` added to `UserRepository` abstract base, `DbUserRepository`, `JsonUserRepository` - `list_users` uses `repo.get_paginated()` with validated bounds (`skip >= 0`, `1 <= limit <= 100`) - Returns `{users, total, skip, limit}` ### Test fixture updates - Seed passwords updated from `pass123` → `pass1234` to meet min-length-8 validation - All test passwords updated to 8+ chars - Rate limiter and revoked JTIs auto-cleared between tests in `conftest.py` ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Verify password validation rejects passwords under 8 chars on create, update, and self-service change - [ ] Verify username validation rejects short, spaced, and special-char usernames - [ ] Test rate limiting: 5 failed logins OK, 6th returns 429 with Retry-After header - [ ] Test logout: POST /api/auth/logout revokes token, subsequent requests with that token return 401 - [ ] Verify GET /api/users/{id}/public returns only id/name/role for any authenticated user - [ ] Confirm GET /api/users/{id} still requires admin role - [ ] Test pagination bounds: skip=-1 → 422, limit=0 → 422, limit=200 → 422 - [ ] Run `cd backend && python -m pytest tests/` — all 73 tests should pass - [ ] Review Alembic migration `c4e2f9a81b03` before applying to production DB ### Notes - Rate limiter and token revocation use in-memory storage (marked with TODO comments for Redis migration) - The `list_users` default limit changed from 50 to 20 and max from 200 to 100 per the review spec Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/31f71bef8c9d48beb3773fa88626d5aa Requested by: @danrocks ---
